title: A Million Bottles a Minute
text: The world buys about 1 million plastic bottles every minute, and the number keeps climbing year after year.

title: Centuries to Break Down
text: A single plastic bottle can take roughly 450 years to decompose — long after we're gone, it's still here.

title: Millions of Tonnes Into the Ocean
text: More than 11 million tonnes of plastic enter the ocean every single year, harming marine life and ecosystems.

title: Only ~9% Is Recycled
text: Of all the plastic ever produced, only about 9% has been recycled. Most ends up in landfills or the environment.

title: Microplastics in Bottled Water
text: Studies found microplastics in 93% of bottled water tested. Tap water in a reusable bottle is often the cleaner choice.

title: Bottled Water Burns Energy
text: Making, filling, and shipping bottled water uses up to 2,000x more energy than producing the same amount of tap water.

title: Always Carry a Reusable Bottle
text: Keep a refillable bottle in your bag. A good stainless-steel bottle keeps water cold for hours and lasts for years.

title: Ask for Tap Water
text: Most cafes and restaurants will happily refill your bottle with tap water for free. All you have to do is ask.

title: Infuse Your Water
text: Add sliced fruit, cucumber, or mint to make tap water exciting — tastier and far cheaper than flavored bottled water.

title: Filter Instead of Buy
text: A simple carbon filter pitcher costs about $25 and can replace hundreds of single-use bottles a year.

title: Keep Your Bottle Fresh
text: Wash reusable bottles daily with warm soapy water, and deep-clean weekly with baking soda and vinegar.

title: Make It Yours
text: Personalize your bottle with stickers or paint pens. You're far more likely to carry something you actually like.

title: Refill on the Go
text: Map out the fountains and refill stations near your school, gym, and workplace so you're never tempted to buy.

title: A Global Plastics Treaty
text: Countries around the world are negotiating a landmark UN treaty to end plastic pollution — the first of its kind.

title: Single-Use Bans Are Spreading
text: Over 100 countries now restrict single-use plastics. Parks, airports, and universities are leading the shift.

title: The Refill Revolution
text: Cities are installing free public refill points, preventing millions of single-use bottles from being bought.
